title: Lacks Automatic Air Quality Monitor Included in “Smart” Model
text:
Lacks Automatic Air Quality Monitor Included in “Smart” Model. I ordered this GERMGUARDIAN AC4825 22" 3-IN-1 FULL ROOM AIR PURIFIER (HEPA Filter, UVC Sanitizer) for my home office because the fancier “smart” model (see [[ASIN:B01LCX9QWG Wi-Fi 4-in-1 GermGuardian]]) has performed so beautifully in my home. I have three of the “smart” air purifiers, in constant operation for more than a year, and none have presented any problems. They clean the air (odors and allergens), and the automatic air quality monitor (not included in this model) speeds up the fans when I cook something that smokes.

The wi-fi feature isn’t terribly useful, so I chose this 3-in-1 model for the additional room with the home office, not realizing that the air quality monitor was omitted (along with the wi-fi capability). The air quality monitor is a feature that matters to me, so this 3-in-1 model isn’t suitable to my needs.
